How is online different from in person?
All sessions happen over a safe video call at a time that works for you.
What if I am not sure it helps?
That is why the first call is free and there is zero obligation to continue.
Can my family or partner join?
Of course. Some sessions welcome a partner or family member at the same price.
How fast do people feel a difference?
Most people feel a shift within six weeks of consistent, weekly work together.
